about: Composition of the 0.2.0 release line: the core and the C/Python bindings of the working tree, pinned per file by git blob id in core.manifest and bindings.manifest, the packaging and acceptance tooling. 2026-10-10: squashed onto v0.1.0 for the public preview; the manifest replaced the base-revision comparison. 2026-10-11: repinned for the Zig 0.17.0 migration and the CPython 3.12-3.15 preparation (Py_LIMITED_API 0x030C0000, abi3 floor cp312); python/bolorgir/_core.c repinned for the explicit (PyObject *) casts of the limited-API build under GCC 14 (manylinux_2_28). Later on 2026-10-11: the line absorbs the session rollback and draft validation (ADR-0014: blg_session_create_ex, blg_session_rollback, blg_validate_tokens; the three symbols join the base ABI), the standalone regex constraint (ADR-0015, BLG_CONSTRAINT_REGEX, src/regex.zig) and the vLLM backend with its pinned patch and agent-evaluation material (ADR-0016, integrations/vllm, benchmarks/agent_eval); core and bindings manifests repinned accordingly and the implemented paths leave later_line_absent. The R6 verdict on record still names the earlier core 6e62e0d1 only, so the release gate stays closed until a new acceptance names the core of these sources; the preview block is untouched for the same reason. Remaining later-line items: ADR-0013 (interop numbers), ADR-0017 (bounded whitespace), the platform workflows and the tokenizer survey/metaspace work (T13/T14 queue).

core.patch: the release-line fix: the open-object certificates of src/complete.zig (pattern keys, dependency doom, the maxProperties count), the reachability flags of src/grammar.zig, the owed-name key completion of src/synth.zig, the -Dstrip option of build.zig; its tests tests/test_open_object_dead_ends.py and tests/completion_reference.py, the isolated acceptance runner (benchmarks/t3/run_t3_accept.sh, t3_identity.py, acceptance_pins.json, acceptance-requirements.txt, tests/test_t3_accept_runner.py) and its CHANGELOG entries come with it

gate.about: Evidence for the final tag (T7b), set by the owner after the gates close: the R6 review verdict and the T8a report, both committed. The release workflow refuses a final tag while either is null, not positive, or bound to another core than the one it builds.

preview.about: GitHub pre-release of an rc tag (owner decision 2026-10-10: public preview 0.2.0rc1 before the final gate). The release workflow builds the core, requires it to be the candidate of this committed, admitted R6 review verdict, and creates a draft pre-release with the wheel, the sdist and SHA256SUMS; nothing goes to PyPI or TestPyPI. The full T8a stays open and the final gate above stays in force for the stable release.
